projects.title: GreenHawk AI
projects.subtitle: AI-powered black & white image colorization platform
projects.shortDescription: An AI-powered web application for black-and-white image colorization using CNN, GAN, and diffusion-based deep learning approaches through a FastAPI backend.
projects.overview: GreenHawk AI is an AI-powered web application for black-and-white image colorization. It brings multiple deep-learning approaches, including CNN, GAN, and diffusion-based models, together behind a FastAPI backend and web interface so users can explore colorization results through a practical software system.
features: Multiple colorization models: Zhang CNN, DeOldify GAN, and FLUX diffusion enhancement
Comparison studio to process one grayscale image through several AI pipelines
Side-by-side result comparison with downloadable outputs
FastAPI backend with REST API architecture and background job management
Image preprocessing, result management, and storage handling
architecture: User uploads a grayscale image through the web interface
FastAPI backend receives the request and orchestrates AI services
Colorization pipeline runs the selected models (Zhang / DeOldify / FLUX)
Storage manager persists generated outputs
Results are returned to the user for comparison and download

projects.title: HAWKLYX — Brent Oil Monitor
projects.subtitle: A smarter way to monitor Brent crude oil markets
projects.shortDescription: A premium Android application for monitoring Brent crude oil prices, featuring interactive historical charts, two dedicated home-screen widgets, and a Cloudflare-powered backend for coordinated market data collection.
projects.overview: HAWKLYX is an Android application designed to make Brent crude oil price monitoring accessible, intuitive, and reliable. Built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, it combines a refined dark interface with interactive historical price charts and two Android home-screen widgets for at-a-glance market insights. Its Cloudflare Workers backend coordinates upstream data requests, persists historical observations, manages refresh quotas, and helps preserve the latest valid price when the upstream provider is temporarily unavailable. The project brings together native Android development, serverless backend engineering, scheduled data collection, persistent coordination, and automated testing in a single end-to-end application.
features: Two dedicated Android home-screen widgets: a compact Market Snapshot widget and a larger Market Intelligence widget.
Interactive historical Brent crude oil price charts with multiple time ranges, including 1 day, 1 week, 1 month, 6 months, and 1 year.
Market price overview with price-change information, timestamps, data freshness indicators, and market-session context.
Refresh and synchronization status indicators for loading, stale data, offline conditions, and temporary service limitations.
Cloudflare-powered backend for coordinating upstream market data requests and serving historical observations.
Persistent historical price storage to support charting without requiring a new upstream request for every chart query.
Scheduled market data collection with configurable upstream request quotas and reserved capacity.
Request coalescing and cooldown mechanisms to reduce duplicate upstream calls.
Last-known-good price preservation during upstream provider failures and market closures.
Server-side isolation of upstream API credentials rather than embedding provider secrets in the Android application.
Automated Android and backend tests, static analysis, dependency auditing, and CI validation.
architecture: Android presentation layer: Kotlin and Jetpack Compose provide the main application interface, market overview, and interactive chart experience.
Widget layer: Android App Widgets and RemoteViews provide compact and expanded home-screen market summaries.
Client data layer: A shared repository and networking components coordinate price retrieval, local data handling, refresh behavior, and presentation state.
Background execution: WorkManager supports scheduled background synchronization according to the application's configured refresh policies.
Backend API: Cloudflare Workers expose the HTTP API consumed by the Android application.
Coordination and persistence: Cloudflare Durable Objects with SQLite coordinate shared backend state, request handling, quotas, and stored observations.
Upstream provider integration: OilPriceAPI supplies market price data through the server-side backend, keeping provider credentials out of the Android client.
Historical data flow: Stored observations are retrieved through the history API and used to render charts across supported time ranges.
Quality assurance: GitHub Actions validates the Android application and Cloudflare Worker through automated tests, linting, type checking, dependency auditing, and build verification.

projects.title: MorseMate Bot
projects.subtitle: Bilingual Telegram bot for Text ↔ Morse conversion
projects.shortDescription: A bilingual English/Persian Telegram bot for reliable Text ↔ Morse conversion, built on Cloudflare Workers.
projects.overview: MorseMate is a lightweight bilingual Telegram bot that converts text to Morse code and Morse code back to text in English and Persian. It runs entirely on Cloudflare Workers, uses Cloudflare KV for persistent user state, and keeps the Morse engine independent from Telegram-specific logic.
features: English and Persian bilingual interface
Text → Morse encoding & Morse → Text decoding
Independent UI and input language selection
Continuous Encode/Decode sessions
Punctuation and Unicode-aware conversion
architecture: Telegram Bot API → Cloudflare Worker → Router / Callbacks / Menus → KV-backed User State
User Input → Language Selection → Morse Encoder/Decoder → Telegram Response
The Morse engine is isolated from Telegram-specific logic and supports separate English/Latin and Persian mappings, deterministic normalization, and non-crashing handling of unsupported characters.

projects.title: HawkBucks
projects.subtitle: Fortnite Save The World V-Bucks mission tracker
projects.shortDescription: A Fortnite Save The World mission tracking platform using React, TypeScript, Cloudflare serverless technologies, APIs, and automation.
projects.overview: HawkBucks is a Fortnite Save The World mission tracking platform. Its React and TypeScript web application works with Cloudflare serverless technologies, APIs, data processing, persistent storage, and automated workflows to turn mission information into a usable web experience.
features: Automatic detection of V-Bucks reward missions from Fortnite mission data
Mission type, area, zone, and Power Level resolution into player-facing information
Fast mission dashboard prioritizing reward, area, mission, and Power Level
Persistent daily mission history stored in Cloudflare D1
Historical summaries with previous-period comparisons
Current mission response cached in Cloudflare KV
architecture: A Cloudflare Worker retrieves Fortnite mission world data on a schedule
Mission alerts are filtered to detect V-Bucks rewards
Mission types, Power Levels, and zones are resolved into readable results
The current response is cached in KV and daily snapshots persist in D1
The React frontend reads normalized mission and history data through the Worker API

Scheduled jobs that process mission data and deliver daily updates
Reminder system for mission resets and availability
Generated mission summary images sent directly to Telegram
Persistent user, group, and channel management
Cloudflare Workers architecture with D1 persistence

The mission data pipeline detects V-Bucks rewards and resolves mission details
Summary images are generated from the processed mission data
Messages and reminders are delivered through the Telegram Bot API
Users, groups, and channels are persisted for reliable delivery
